notes.title: Version 23.6.15
notes.content:
Thank you for the support in finding the issues! 

- Removed possible softlock in Book 4 related to not receiving a faith vessel in a cryochamber on the first floor (anyone currently softlocked there should also get a faith vessel to their inventory)
- Removed possible softlock in Book 3 related to completing quests before talking to Mikail
- Relentless Warrior and Jack of All Trades achievements are now fixed (...again!)
- Factory crowd members won't talk after being defeated anymore
- No more being stuck inside the kitchen door
- Removed redundant dialogue options from tape player in Book 4
- Added missing sounds when closing a suitcase in Day 4
- Multiple camera fixes
- Multiple localization and spellchecking fixes

notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Dive into the world of [b]The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales[/b] with our brand [b]new demo[/b]!

Etienne Quist is a writer-turned-thief with a unique ability to dive into the very pages of books. Once a celebrated writer, his creative freedom was stripped away when he was found guilty of an unspeakable crime. Now tasked by a criminal boss, Etienne must venture into mesmerizing book realms, seeking legendary artifacts to restore his creative abilities.

[list]
[*] Step into the living pages of book worlds as The Bookwalker.
[*] Explore unique worlds, each with its own mysteries to uncover.
[*] Embark on daring artifact heists to reclaim your creative freedom.
[*] Solve unconventional puzzles, wield the power of magical ink, and encounter intriguing characters whose stories hold the key to your journey.
[*] Face obstacles on your quest for artifacts. Be prepared to persuade, deceive, or even engage in combat.
[/list]
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432100/The_Bookwalker_Thief_of_Tales/]PLAY THE NEW DEMO![/url][/h3]

P.S. Don't forget to join us on our [url=https://t.co/MzwFsIfVai]Discord[/url] server, where you can connect with players, and stay up to date with all things The Final Station, The Bookwalker, and our upcoming projects!
